items.t: Aminophylline, IV, 5 mg/kg, loading dose administered over 20–30 minutes. Omit loading dose in children receiving maintenance oral theophylline.
Aminophylline, IV/oral: · Loading dose: 8 mg/kg. (If IV infusion, administer over 30 minutes.) · Maintenance dose: 1.5–3 mg/kg/dose 8 hourly. Start maintenance dose

cautions.t: Omit the loading dose if already on theophylline
Levels raised by ciprofloxacin and macrolides, lowered by rifampicin and smoking
